Operand binding: old vd=C accumulator；vs1=A[M,K]；vs2=physical B^T[N,K]；new vd=D；vftta.vv has 3 explicit operands (vm encoded control)
RTL + Spike mandatory；CycleSim 2x2x4-style capability-gated；16 meaningful D / 32 writeback lanes and fflags verify/freeze
M4 disabled until complete M3 manifest；M1/M2 basic backend path remains actionable
